dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did you know? The reeds in Dihua Marsh are common materials used in making paper.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The solid reed cores are used to make pens, while the hollow part is used to make flutes, and it's considered an elegant art in Liyue.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Over the years, many heroes and swordmen have also chosen Dihua Marsh as the location of their duels.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The more reeds, the more elegant the place. But in places where the reeds are the thickest, the water can be quite deep...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So there are lots of unlucky duelists who fall in and drown while the duel is on...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: And what's my takeaway from this supposed to be?
